title: Northwind SMB
summary: A Samba file server with a guest-readable share (KeePass vault + hints) and a Linux pivot host. The vault master is not in rockyou — it is derivable from a naming convention in the HR notes; cracking it yields reused SSH creds to the pivot's customer contracts.

loot.description: the HR note that reveals the vault master-password convention
the KeePass vault left on the guest-readable public share
Q3 customer contracts on the pivot host (reached via reused creds)
